text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "The Yasuda Kinen... It's finally here: the race to crown the spring mile champion."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The longest straight in Tokyo...
Everyone will be pushing at full throttle.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "That's exactly why blowing past 'em will feel so damn good! All those monster cars packing the ultimate engines—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Break away from the pack with a nimble burst!
Nothing beats this feeling, right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, you think you can do it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I can do it.
If the legs you and I polished are the real deal, that is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She accelerated as if gliding across the earth—
reaching top speed in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If we can pull this off, I'm guaranteed to run a good race.
Even against these heavy hitters.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's when the new me will be born!
choice_data_list: Alright, get those fans fired up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Getting drunk on your own ego is just kinda uncool anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I'm gonna intoxicate this packed stadium of fans
all at once. With my ultimate weapon!"
